{{Quote|Suspicious about the boy's power, his father confronted his mother, who admitted to having an affair with the Sith Lord who ruled over them.|Darth Nyriss|<ref name="Revan" />}}
A [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the '''adoptive father''' of [[Tenebrae]] and was a [[Farm/Legends|farmer]]<ref name="Revan" /> on the [[Nathema's northern continent|northern continent]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nathema|Medriaas]], an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] on the edge of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. The farmer [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a [[Tenebrae's mother|woman]] who was a [[Color/Legends|red]]-skinned Sith like himself<ref name="Revan" /> around [[5113 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> and he believed that Tenebrae, the child she [[Reproduction/Legends|bore]] not long into their marriage, was his. However, the man was outraged when Tenebrae began to exhibit signs of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]]<ref name="Revan" /> in [[5107 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> as neither he nor his wife had power in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. When he confronted his wife, she confessed that Tenebrae was the result of an affair with Lord [[Dramath]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ruler of their world, but Tenebrae [[Consume Essence|fed off]] of the man's anger and [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] [[Death/Legends|broke]] his adoptive father's neck when the man attacked his mother. The Sith Lord [[Darth Nyriss]] explained the story of Tenebrae's father [[3954 BBY|over a millennium]] later to her fellow Sith [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] while describing Tenebrae's history.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tenebrae's adoptive father was first mentioned in Chapter 15 of [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''.<ref name="Revan" />
